title: AgentActionEnvelope
description: A network action proposed by an identified agent, together with the delegated authority it claims. Everything here is a claim until horizon_agentic.identity verifies the signature and horizon_agentic.envelope.authorize checks it against the operator's policy; the envelope itself proves nothing.

agent_id.description: Identity claimed by the agent. Meaningless without a verifying signature: any process can set this string.

target_domain.description: The domain the action targets. Only 'ran' is implemented; the field admits the possibility of others and nothing more.

granted_scopes.description: Scopes the agent claims. The effective set is the intersection with the operator's grant, so over-claiming gains nothing and is refused.

delegation_chain.description: Ordered principals from the operator root to this agent. Valid only if each step holds a subset of its delegator's scopes and domains: delegation narrows, never widens.

requested_action.description: The action, in the key contract of horizon_ric.assurance.planner. Carries every REQUIRED_ACTION_KEY, including keys the agent is only declaring rather than changing.

mutates.description: The subset of requested_action the agent asks to CHANGE. Everything else is declared state and must match the baseline. This distinction is required: REQUIRED_ACTION_KEYS forces every action to carry frequency_hz, bandwidth_hz and tx_power_dBm, so authority keyed on key presence would make a legal slice action impossible to express.

nonce.description: Unique per agent. A signature without a nonce is replayable indefinitely.

issued_at.description: Epoch seconds. Bounds how long a captured envelope stays useful, and is what allows the nonce set to be evicted rather than growing without limit.

signature.description: Hex Ed25519 signature over the canonical envelope bytes, which include mutates, granted_scopes and delegation_chain — the fields authority actually reads. Deliberately not length-pinned, matching the A1 assurance envelope.

signing_key_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the raw Ed25519 public key. Advisory: the signature already binds the key, but a mismatch signals a misconfiguration worth refusing on.

resource_id.description: The physical resource the action addresses — a cell, sector or carrier. Every aggregate limit that matters in RAN is scoped to one. Without it, two agents describing the SAME cell are indistinguishable from two carriers: a summing invariant manufactures power that does not exist, and a pair-wise one reports two co-sited carriers as overlapping.
